scientific_integrity: A uniform proof by cycle-Hessian rank and scheme transport is provided; finite exact checks are ancillary. Originality is based on explicit literature and published-finding comparisons; no independent audit or certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The classification is only on the projective coordinate torus, not the entire singular locus. The analytic germ statement is over the complex numbers. Positivity of cyclic determinant weights is essential to the parity criterion.
title: Transverse quadratic nodes along the balanced polygonal universal-adjoint torus line
